label: post-registration coupling-switch and directed-repair study
scope: same integer CLOB and full local gate; existing frozen sources and results remain unchanged
coupling_intervention: only side/quantity world scopes change from shared to baseline-only/policy-only; family and parameters unchanged; policy-only branch roles unchanged

replicate_sweep.session_rule: batch equals zero, all four workload cells

horizon_sweep.session_rule: six agents, batch zero or one, both book regimes

thresholds: exact slot/key/plan equality; lexicographic ties; zero regret retained; no fitted numerical tolerance
seed_rule: unchanged: commitment([original seed_root, session_id, replicate]); full RunSpec determines event namespace
target_replicate: sha256(session id + mechanism-slot) modulo panel replicate count
decision_rule: unchanged exact mean paired notional, descending with lexicographic ties

repair_study.oracle: semantic recipe/plan catalog from sealed original attempt schedule; no diagnostic/key-hash output used as truth
repair_study.observable_truth: final residual slot obligations, not all historical injected operations
repair_study.store: complete original revised store, initial plan permitted; object recovery is measured separately from new execution

auxiliary_analysis.normalized_regret: absolute finite-panel regret / max(1, max absolute reference candidate mean); descriptive, does not replace absolute regret
auxiliary_analysis.timing: all 32 existing complete fresh/reuse paired times; per-cell IQR, paired differences, slower session; no invented retroactive phase clocks or break-even threshold

reference_types: full fresh within new coupling panels; prior replicate extension remains partially shared
failure_policy: write-once attempts; retain failures, local rejection, zero effects and undefined ratios; no retries or replacement seeds
expected_claims: comparison authorization and outcome-independent directed repair under explicit trusted semantics; no new cache/join primitive, no universal speedup or human-team claim
